issue.title: No way to create an empty alias

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
As a followup to #7863, it would be nice if alias actions with a null `index` created a new alias that matched zero indices. When queried, the alias would behave like a wildcard specifier that matches zero indices:

```
$ curl 'localhost:9200/missing-index*/_count'
{"count":0,"_shards":{"total":0,"successful":0,"failed":0}}
```

I'd be fine with this being off by default to preserve the historical behavior.

body: I learned in #7864 that empty aliases are technically impossible, so I edited the issue to recommend raising an error.

issue.title: Updating cluster commands

repository.name: elastomer-client
repository.description: A library for interacting with Elasticsearch

issue.body:
Over the next several weeks I'll be taking a pass through the ElasticSearch documentation and the elastomer-client code ensuring the two actually agree. To that end I'm updating method documentation and tests in our codebase, adding missing methods, and pruning deprecated methods.

This is the first of many changes.

/cc @github/search
